versions.changelog: Add Stage 1 tool registration metadata to SKILL.md (6 tools with params, read-only flags, confirm hints)

Code hardening: UID support, Chinese date parsing, month/nextmonth queries, full event extraction (description+rrule+uid), update rrule support, search in description, shared search helper, 29 unit tests
5 new features: RRULE recurring events, keyword search, operation logging, code cleanup, deduplicated parser
Added bilingual README (CN/EN), CONFIG.md setup guide, improved description
Full CRUD: create, query, update, delete events. Smart duration inference, auto calendar selection, keyword-based bulk operations.
